body: Opus2 lesson (2026-11-21): before landing anything on TermAl master, check whether a higher-priority candidate is in flight on the current master (focused run, pair or FULL under way). Landing moves master under it, so its FULL must then run on a fresh re-cut whose parent is the new master, and any test ref already cut on the old master can no longer gate a landing. On 2026-11-21 I landed w-3c02 (Markdown) at 16:56Z while w-b646 (Greg's source_id priority, e9956f3e on 1fd1e156) was in its focused run, and while combo91's test ref 4234f2de (on 1fd1e156) was queued for a FULL. Both needed re-cuts, and combo91's queued FULL was wasted. Rule: while a priority candidate is in flight, hold other TermAl landings, or ask the coordinator first.
